title: The Legend of Sleepy Hollow
focus: superstition used against a credulous man

teacherSummary.text: In the Dutch hamlet of Sleepy Hollow, lanky, superstitious schoolmaster Ichabod Crane courts the heiress Katrina Van Tassel, partly for her father's rich farm. His rival is the strong prankster Brom Bones. After a party where ghost stories are told, Ichabod rides home and is chased by a Headless Horseman who hurls his head at him. Ichabod disappears; a shattered pumpkin is found. Brom marries Katrina and looks knowing when the tale is told.
